content_sections.text: PRSC has announced a total of 6 vacancies for Clerk, Lab Attendant, Lab Executive, Chowkidar cum Mali and Sweeper posts.

content_sections.heading: Punjab Remote Sensing Centre Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for PRSC Recruitment 2026 should fulfil the educational qualification and other eligibility requirements prescribed for each post. Graduate with second division or above from a recognized University. Punjabi up to Matric level. Minimum 120 hours computer course with practical experience from a recognized institution. OR DOEACC "O" Level Computer Certificate. Must qualify Punjabi and English typing test at the required speed. The selection process for Clerk includes Punjabi Language Qualifying Test, Written Test and Typing Test. Passed 10+2 examination with Science subjects. Subjects may include Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Environmental Science, Biotechnology, Biochemistry or related subjects. Punjabi up to Matric level. Selection will include Punjabi Language Qualifying Test, Written Test and Skill Test. First Class Diploma/BCA/B.Sc in Information Technology, Electronics & Communication, Computer Science or Computer Science Engineering. Must have passed Punjabi language examination up to Matric level or equivalent. Selection will include Punjabi Language Qualifying Test, Written Test and Skill Test. Passed Matric with Punjabi from a recognized board. Minimum 2 years experience in Government Department, Autonomous Body or reputed organization. Candidates having watch and ward training from a recognized organization will be preferred. Passed Matriculation with Punjabi Language as one of the subjects from a recognized institution. Selection will include Punjabi Language Qualifying Test, Written Test and Skill Test.

content_sections.text: The notification mentions that fixed emoluments equal to minimum pay without allowances will be paid during the probation period of 3 years as per Punjab Government notifications.

content_sections.heading: Punjab Remote Sensing Centre Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee is non-refundable as mentioned in the recruitment notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Punjab Remote Sensing Centre Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from the PRSC website. Fill in all required details correctly. Attach self-attested copies of certificates, testimonials and supporting documents. Attach the required application fee through online mode or Demand Draft. Send the completed application form to Punjab Remote Sensing Centre, PAU Campus, Ludhiana. Ensure that the application reaches before 05 October 2026. The prescribed application form can be downloaded from the PRSC website. Applications complete in all respects along with documents and fee must be submitted to PRSC office.

content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Experience certificates Identity proof Category certificate, if applicable Application fee payment proof Other supporting documents

content_sections.heading: Punjab Remote Sensing Centre Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process varies according to the post. Candidates may be shortlisted based on application details and called for written/practical tests, typing tests, skill tests, physical tests or interviews as applicable. Punjabi Language Qualifying Test (Minimum 50% Marks) Written Test Typing Test Skill Test Physical Test (for Chowkidar cum Mali) The notification states that screening will be conducted based on bio-data to shortlist candidates for interview, written/practical test as required.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in PRSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Punjab Remote Sensing Centre has announced 6 vacancies for Clerk, Lab Attendant, Lab Executive, Chowkidar cum Mali and Sweeper posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for PRSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 05 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for PRSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates have to apply through offline mode by sending the application form through registered/speed post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for PRSC Clerk Post?
faq.answer: Candidates should be graduates with second division, Punjabi up to Matric level and required computer qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Punjab Remote Sensing Centre Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 37 years as on 01 August 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of PRSC Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: The pay scale ranges from Rs. 18,000 Level-1 to Rs. 19,900 Level-2 depending on the post.
